title: FIX: breadcrumb/section indicator updates unreliable across categories
description: Reported 2026-06-29. The E3 topbar section indicator (scroll-spy via IntersectionObserver in Settings.vue) updates unreliably on all categories. Likely root cause: the observer uses the VIEWPORT as root with rootMargin '0px 0px -70% 0px', but after the E3 sticky app-shell the sections scroll inside .settings-content (which starts ~150px below the viewport top, under the fixed topbar+search). The detection band no longer aligns with the content pane, so the 'topmost visible section' pick is flaky (last section may never reach the band; updates lag/skip). Proper fix: set observer root to the .settings-content scroll container and tune rootMargin relative to it (or compute the active section from scrollTop). Use systematic-debugging; verify on-device across Plugins/Content/Device/Maintenance.
close_reason: Fixed on feat/design-settings-cycle-c (a4dc497..b39d0b8). Root causes: scroll-spy matched .settings-section (incl. embedded CollapsibleSections without eyebrows) and short trailing sections couldn't reach a top reference line. Now keys off .settings-section__eyebrow with midpoint activation + at-bottom clamp; observer→scroll-position compute rooted at .settings-content. On-device verified across Content (4/4 sections) and Maintenance (3/3). 704 tests.

title: Admin ⋯ menu opens off-screen on the vertical clock bar
description: The AdminOverflow (⋯) menu is position:absolute with top:calc(100%+8px); right:0 — correct for the top horizontal bar but wrong on a vertical/side bar, where the ⋯ trigger sits at the bottom corner. Playwright repro (left vertical bar, 1280x800): trigger at (8,746); menu renders at x=-146 (off left edge), y=800 (off bottom) — completely off-screen, so it appears not to open. Fix: viewport-aware placement — open upward when the trigger is in the lower half, and align toward content (left-anchored on a left bar, right-anchored on a right bar) based on the trigger's position. Found while verifying calvin-rvd (2026-06-30).
close_reason: Fixed on feat/design-settings-cycle-c: viewport-aware placement (open up when trigger in lower half, left-anchor when in left half) + max-height backstop. Playwright-verified: vertical-bar menu now on-screen (was off bottom+left); horizontal unchanged. 2 placement unit tests; 737 pass; eslint clean.

title: Cannot navigate between screens (pages) on a vertical clock bar — no ScreenDots
description: User (2026-06-30): cannot navigate between pages (dashboard screens) via touch. Root cause: ScreenDots (the per-screen pager + tap-to-activate) is rendered only in ClockBarHorizontal, not ClockBarVertical. With a left/right (vertical) clock bar there is no touch affordance to switch screens at all. Verified via Playwright repro: horizontal-bar dots render and tapping switches the active screen correctly (frontend + backend round-trip dashboardScreens.activeScreenId as JSON); the vertical bar has zero ScreenDots. Fix: render ScreenDots in ClockBarVertical (stacked) with the same screens/activeScreenId/activateScreen wiring.
close_reason: Fixed on feat/design-settings-cycle-c: added ScreenDots (vertical-stacked) to ClockBarVertical with screens/activeScreenId/activateScreen wiring. Playwright-verified: vertical bar dots render + tap switches screens. Horizontal already worked; backend round-trips dashboardScreens.activeScreenId as JSON. 735 tests, eslint clean.

title: Settings section indicator shows LAST section on short (non-scrolling) categories
description: Found reviewing closed calvin-8ou. Settings.vue computeActiveSection() at-bottom clamp (lines ~171-177): when a category's content fits without scrolling, scrollTop=0 and clientHeight≈scrollHeight, so 'scrollTop+clientHeight >= scrollHeight-4' is permanently true and the topbar shows eyebrows[last] instead of the topmost section. Hits maintenance/clock-bar/plugins (2-3 sections) on any viewport tall enough not to scroll. Not caught by calvin-8ou's on-device check, where those categories presumably scrolled. Fix: only apply the clamp when the pane is actually scrollable (scrollHeight - clientHeight > epsilon).
close_reason: Fixed on feat/design-settings-cycle-c (commit follows): scroll-owner detection (pane vs window) + scrollability-gated bottom clamp, extracted to pure settingsSectionSpy.js with 10 unit tests. 724 frontend tests pass; eslint clean.

title: Clock-bar sizing picker: live-preview feedback loop makes sliders unusable
description: Regression from calvin-hbp (embedded-editor restyle). ClockBarFontSizePicker was placed in a SettingRow control slot (.setting-row__control is flex-shrink:0, content-sized). The live preview's intrinsic width grows with font size (nowrap time text; .preview-vertical had min-width:fit-content), so dragging a size slider grew the preview -> grew the non-shrinking control -> changed the slider's own length under the user's finger. Both horizontal and vertical sizing rows affected. calvin-hbp closed as 'visually verified' but this slipped through.
design: Fixed on feat/design-settings-cycle-c: (1) added a 'stacked' variant to SettingRow (column layout, full-width shrinkable control) so wide editors get a definite, content-independent width; (2) ClockBarSettings uses stacked for both sizing rows; (3) ClockBarFontSizePicker preview wrappers no longer force intrinsic width (removed min-width:fit-content, added width:100%/min-width:0). 49 settings tests + new stacked-variant test pass; eslint clean.
close_reason: Fixed on feat/design-settings-cycle-c (uncommitted at time of close): SettingRow 'stacked' variant + ClockBarSettings stacked rows + ClockBarFontSizePicker preview width decoupling. Tests + lint green.

title: Settings shell UX: sticky chrome + breadcrumb discoverability/behavior
description:
Two related fixes to the settings SHELL (topbar, search, category rail, Settings.vue layout) — NOT plugin/category content. Run as one cycle after the Plugins shell migration (calvin-e00).

1. STICKY CHROME (user request 2026-06-29): currently .settings-page is min-height:100vh and the WINDOW scrolls everything together (topbar+search+rail+content). Make the chrome stay put so only the options pane scrolls. Recommended: app-shell — .settings-page = fixed 100dvh flex column (no document scroll); topbar + .settings-search-wrapper fixed bands; 220px rail column fixed-height; only .settings-content gets overflow-y:auto. Best for the wall/kiosk display. Lighter alt: position:sticky on topbar/search + sticky rail with align-self:start. Verify the SettingsSearch dropdown overflow and the scroll-spy IntersectionObserver still behave with the new scroll owner. Check 768px responsive breakpoint (rail collapses to 1 col).

2. BREADCRUMB discoverability + behavior: breadcrumb renders (SettingsTopBar: Settings > Category > Section) but is undiscoverable — small low-contrast --ink-2 text jammed against the CAL.VIN wordmark, doesn't look interactive; invisible on a wall display. AND the section (3rd) crumb scroll-spy is hardcoded dashboard-only (Settings.vue setupSectionObserver returns early + clears sectionLabel for non-dashboard; watch(activeCategory) only sets it up for dashboard). Every migrated category (content/device/maintenance/clock-bar/plugins) shows at most 'Settings > Category' with no live section crumb. Fixes: (a) bump contrast/size + separate from wordmark + interactive affordance; (b) consider redundancy — the left CategoryRail already highlights the active category, so 'Settings > Category' partly duplicates it (decide: keep, or show only section-depth); (c) un-gate the scroll-spy to run for ALL categories in MIGRATED_CATEGORIES (SettingsSection already emits .settings-section + .settings-section__eyebrow, so it works once un-gated). Sticky chrome (#1) also keeps the breadcrumb permanently visible, reinforcing the fix. Needs its own brainstorm/design before implementation. New code uses new semantic tokens only; preserve focus-visible.
close_reason: Shipped on feat/design-settings-cycle-c (PR #60), commits e78db66..a8f2b81. Sticky app-shell layout (only .settings-content scrolls; fixed top bar/search/rail; small-viewport fallback) + replaced the invisible/redundant Settings>Category>Section breadcrumb with a prominent live section indicator (sectionLabel||categoryLabel) + un-gated the scroll-spy from dashboard-only to all migrated categories. Subagent-driven, reviewed clean (final review confirmed viewport-root observer sound under new scroll container); on-device verified. 704 tests, eslint 0.

title: Settings section indicator frozen at <=768px / short-height (overflow-y:visible)
description: Found reviewing closed calvin-8ou. The scroll listener attaches to .settings-content (Settings.vue ~242). At the 768px and short-height responsive breakpoints the CSS sets .settings-content{overflow-y:visible} so the window scrolls, not that element — the listener never fires and the section indicator never updates (and the bug-1 clamp is also permanently true there, freezing it on the last section). The calvin-4zj bead explicitly named the 768px breakpoint. Fix: attach to window / detect the actual scroll owner when the pane isn't the scroller.
close_reason: Fixed on feat/design-settings-cycle-c (commit follows): scroll-owner detection (pane vs window) + scrollability-gated bottom clamp, extracted to pure settingsSectionSpy.js with 10 unit tests. 724 frontend tests pass; eslint clean.
